summary: Iter50 — Accessibility widget, Claude 4.5 SafeBase Concierge chat, customer dashboard sidebar scroll, admin force-logout, network-pulse removal, industry-page testimonials redesign, money-back copy removal, Emergent badge removal. Backend 14/14 pytest tests pass (test_iter50_concierge_a11y_forcelogout.py) covering /api/concierge/chat (Claude 4.5 reply includes 'A$799' + '+ GST'), /api/concierge/history chronological order, /api/accessibility/preferences GET/PUT anonymous + authenticated round-trip, POST /api/internal-admin/users/{user_id}/force-logout invalidating old JWT via password_changed_at bump + audit log entry, and auth/internal-admin regression. Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright: #emergent-badge removed; [data-testid='a11y-toggle'] + [data-testid='chat-toggle'] visible on every page; all 7 a11y toggles (contrast, dyslexia, pause-anim, highlight-links, big-cursor, reading-guide, font scale 1.3) flip html attributes + persist to localStorage 'sb_a11y_prefs_v1'; a11y-reset clears them. Chat widget header shows 'SafeBase concierge … CLAUDE 4.5'; sending 'What is the price for trades?' returns Claude reply containing 'A$799/month + GST' within ~5s; chat-new clears localStorage 'sb_chat_session_v1'. Homepage home-industry-pulse-trades block shows only 'THIS WEEK' eyebrow (no 'Network pulse · live'). /pricing, /register, /about contain zero 'money-back' strings. All 5 industry pages (/industries/{trades,hospitality,transport,healthcare,retail}) expose [data-testid='industry-testimonials-{industry}'] with dark bg (~rgb(10,10,10)) + 'VERIFIED SAFEBASE CUSTOMER' pill. Customer dashboard sidebar at 1366×700: [data-testid='dashboard-sidebar-nav'] has overflow-y-auto + custom-scrollbar classes; scrollHeight=1952 vs clientHeight=426 → genuinely scrollable. Admin → Account Detail → Users tab shows 'FORCE LOGOUT' button per row with [data-testid='admin-force-logout-{user_id}']. ONE BACKEND BUG FOUND & FIXED IN-FLIGHT: the global `trial_gate` middleware in server.py was returning 402 for authenticated PUT /api/accessibility/preferences and POST /api/concierge/chat when the customer's trial had expired — that broke a11y prefs persistence and the support chatbot for the very users who need them. Added '/api/accessibility/' and '/api/concierge/' to _TRIAL_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES (one-line fix). After fix all 14 backend tests pass cleanly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend trial_gate middleware (server.py ~line 2469) is a sweeping block on writes for expired trials. Every new endpoint that must work in read-only/expired-trial state must be added to _TRIAL_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES. The owner@safetradie.demo account is currently in expired-trial state in dev — useful for testing this gate. Force-logout test invalidates the customer JWT; the test re-logs in at the end to restore demo state, but if a future test caches a token from before the force-logout it WILL get 401 — always acquire a fresh token per session.
rca of the issue: Bug: PUT /api/accessibility/preferences and POST /api/concierge/chat returned 402 'trial_expired' for any authenticated user whose trial had ended. Reproduction: log in as owner@safetradie.demo (trial expired in this env), call PUT /api/accessibility/preferences → 402. Root cause: server.py trial_gate middleware allowlist (_TRIAL_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES) did not include /api/accessibility/ or /api/concierge/, but accessibility prefs and the support chatbot are exactly the kind of feature that must work for expired-trial users (a11y for WCAG, chat for trial-recovery conversations). Mitigation applied: added both prefixes to the allowlist tuple — single-line code change, no logic re-architecture needed. Verified by re-running the failing test (test_put_authenticated_persists_and_roundtrip) post-fix — now passes alongside the other 13.
